bull.b: Snowflake's TTM operating cash flow (~$1.24B) and free cash flow (~$1.17B) show robust cash conversion despite GAAP losses. Sustainable positive FCF supports continued product investment, buybacks, and the ability to fund AI initiatives or M&A without immediate equity raises, improving medium-term durability.

bull.t: High product gross margins and durable unit economics
bull.b: Management's maintained 75% non‑GAAP product gross margin guide and historically strong gross profitability indicate attractive unit economics from the consumption model. High gross margins underpin scalable margins as usage and higher-value workloads (analytics/AI) expand across multi-cloud deployments over the medium term.

Large multi-year deals (expanded $6B AWS agreement, $200M OpenAI tie-up) plus stronger net revenue retention (126%) and growing counts of $1M+/ $10M+ customers deepen Snowflake's ecosystem moat. These structural partnerships and enterprise expansion support durable upsell and platform entrenchment.

bear.t: Persistent GAAP unprofitability and negative margins
bear.b: Despite strong gross margins, Snowflake's TTM net margin near -24% and ongoing operating losses mean sustained reliance on cash generation and efficient expense control. Long-term shareholder returns hinge on translating gross profitability into consistent GAAP profitability as scale and expense discipline progress.

Debt-to-equity rising to ~1.35–1.42 while ROE remains deeply negative increases refinancing, covenant, and liquidity risk. Elevated leverage constrains flexibility for large investments or acquisitions and raises sensitivity to rate cycles, making financial risk a material medium-term concern until profitability improves.

bear.t: AI product margin pressure and consumption risk
bear.b: Native AI features drive usage but carry materially lower gross margins, and management flags AI-related cost pressure. If customers also apply governance or throttle consumption to control spend, per-customer revenue growth could slow, constraining the upside of AI-driven consumption expansion.
